shortDescription: Reusable new membership registration summary layout.
fullDescription: Reusable membership-registration component that presents a two-step progress rail, personal data summary, contact details, address information, secondary membership cards, and footer actions for returning home, saving changes, or continuing to payment. It is designed for PriceSmart-style onboarding and can be reused for review flows that need structured member information sections and action controls similar to the reference image 1777781281647-hz7g5mgy2b8.jpeg.

shortDescription: Reusable membership entry screen with quick actions and customer search.
fullDescription: Reusable membership landing component that renders a compact PriceSmart-branded header, two primary action cards for starting a new membership or checking pending processes, and a centered search section for locating an existing membership by name, phone, email, or membership ID. It supports membership onboarding entry points and lookup-focused account flows matching the reference image 1777781280776-hz85g27aqjj.jpeg.

shortDescription: Membership search and onboarding landing screen.
fullDescription: View for starting customer membership workflows from a single page. The screen includes a branded top bar, quick-entry cards for creating a new membership and reviewing pending processes, and a membership search form with a disabled submit state for finding existing profiles before registration. It uses the shared MembershipLanding component for the full composition.
